baseline: Pre-change working tree on main at da1c157, including local startup changes
platform: Windows, Python 3.13.5, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, torch 2.10.0+cu128

recorder.method: Median of five runs of scripts/benchmark_recorder.py per duration. Mono float32 at 16 kHz, 800 samples per callback, one VAD read per callback, no intermediate drain. Times exclude capture, VAD inference and transcription.

settings.method: Native Windows Qt backend, hidden window, system fonts, default 560 logical pixels, 506-pixel viewport. Read horizontal scrollbar maximum after layout.

dictation.method: Three separate Python processes per version, fresh temporary settings profiles, cached offline Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on CUDA, speaker verification disabled. Timings from probe entry, before importing the app, to ASR attachment, warmup completion and detection of the first text insertion call. A timer submitted the same 2.735-second synthetic English clip once the engine was attached and warm. Input stream, global hotkeys, sound and destination clipboard were substituted. This is a first-warmed-transcript comparison.
dictation.expected_transcript: Please bring the meeting notes tomorrow.
